definitions.gloss: tidying up, cleaning up, putting away
definitions.explanation: The act of organizing and putting things in order.
Completing or settling a matter or task.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{片付|かたづ}けをする。
{片付|かたづ}けが{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm not good at tidying up.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{後|あと}は{片付|かたづ}けを{手伝|てつだ}う。
examples.english: I help clean up after meals.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{前|まえ}に{片付|かたづ}けをしなければならない。
examples.english: I have to tidy up before moving.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{自分|じぶん}の{部屋|へや}の{片付|かたづ}けをさせるのは{大変|たいへん}だが、{小|ちい}さい{時|とき}から{習慣|しゅうかん}にすることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Getting children to tidy their own room is tough, but it's important to make it a habit from a young age.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{片付|かたづ}けが{早|はや}い。
examples.english: She's quick at finishing up work.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{片付|かたづ}けに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to settle the problem.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}の{片付|かたづ}けが{終|お}わったら{次|つぎ}の{仕事|しごと}に{取|と}りかかる。
examples.english: Once I finish dealing with the paperwork, I'll start on the next task.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{たまった|たまった}{仕事|しごと}の{片付|かたづ}けに{一日|いちにち}かかってしまった。
examples.english: Today it took me the whole day to get through the accumulated work.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{トラブル|とらぶる}の{片付|かたづ}けがまだ{終|お}わっていないのに、{新|あたら}しい{問題|もんだい}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: Even though I haven't finished settling last year's trouble, a new problem has come up.

notes:
{片付|かたづ}け is the noun form of {片付|かたづ}ける (to tidy up).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {片付|かたづ}けをする (to do tidying up)
- {片付|かたづ}けが{上手|じょうず}/{苦手|にがて} (good/bad at tidying)
- {片付|かたづ}けを{手伝|てつだ}う (to help tidy up)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {部屋|へや}の{片付|かたづ}け (room tidying)
- {食後|しょくご}の{片付|かたづ}け (cleaning up after meals)
- {大|おお}{掃除|そうじ} (big cleaning, spring cleaning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {片付|かたづ}け: tidying, organizing
- {掃除|そうじ}: cleaning (removing dirt)
- {整理|せいり}: organizing, arranging
